summary: Encodes an end-of-block marker into the bitstream shift register at this+0x16AB by OR-ing '2 << bitCount'. Accumulates bits while bitCount is small; when the register overflows, flushes two bytes to the output buffer (base this+0x8, offset this+0x14) and re-anchors the remaining bits. A capacity check on this+0x16A7 may force a second marker write and flush. Completes by calling BitStreamWriter and setting capacity this+0x16A7 to 7.

operations.description: Read bitCount at this+0x16AD. If bitCount <= 13, accumulate the marker; else flush the two-byte register.
Append end-of-block marker bits: OR this+0x16AB with (2 << bitCount).
Accumulate path: bitCount at this+0x16AD becomes bitCount + 3.

Flush path: write low byte of this+0x16AB to buffer[base + offset] and high byte (this+0x16AC) to buffer[base + offset + 1] using base this+0x8 and offset this+0x14; advance offset by 2; bitCount -= 13; shift register this+0x16AB becomes (2 >> (16 - oldBitCount)).
Re-read bitCount at this+0x16AD; if bitCount <= 9, accumulate, else flush again.
Accumulate path: bitCount at this+0x16AD becomes bitCount + 7.

Second flush path: write low byte of this+0x16AB to buffer[base + offset] and high byte (this+0x16AC) to buffer[base + offset + 1]; advance offset this+0x14 by 2; bitCount -= 9; shift register this+0x16AB cleared to 0.
Call BitStreamWriter(this) to write the completed bitstream block; return value retained as result.
Capacity check: if (capacity at this+0x16A7 - bitCount + 11) < 9, encode another end-of-block marker and flush.
Marker-repeat branch mirrors the initial encode/flush: OR this+0x16AB with (2 << bitCount), accumulate or flush by the 13-bit threshold, then by the 9-bit threshold, and call BitStreamWriter again.
Set capacity this+0x16A7 to 7 on completion.
Return the retained result of BitStreamWriter(this).
